items.docs:
Check which sync-managed resources have changed for the current user.

Auth: JWT-only (``Authenticated()``). This endpoint must NOT use
``get_current_user_stateless`` — its only DB touch is the IP-allowlist
check inside ``Authenticated()`` (a per-user cached join, skipped while
enforcement is disabled). If this endpoint is ever extended to return
actual user data, upgrade auth accordingly.

Returns 503 if Redis is unreachable so the client can skip the cycle
and retry on the next interval.
